name: UI Verify for Open Source
description: Free visual regression testing for open source projects, built for coding agents. Includes 50,000 snapshots per month, self-serve at sign-up with no approval and no credit card.

perks.title: Free Visual Testing
perks.description: 50,000 snapshots per month at no cost for open source projects, 5 times the standard free tier.

perks.title: Reuses Existing Tests
perks.description: Works with existing Storybook stories, Playwright tests, or Vitest browser-mode tests, with GitHub pull request checks and comments.

perks.title: Agent Workflow
perks.description: A CLI and a remote MCP server let coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex check what a change did to the UI while they work. An AI judge labels each visual change as intended, a regression, or flake.

eligibility: The project must be open source with a public repository.
The open source tier is self-declared, with no verification step.
applicationProcess: Click Get started on the open source callout on the UI Verify pricing page or in the open source docs.
Sign up; the open source tier is applied to your first workspace automatically.
